game.agy.summary: Kismeta: Alchemists of the Great Year is a strategic card-and-dice game where you and up to three friends take on the roles of rival Alchemists. Your quest is to complete the Great Work, transforming your Philosopher's Stone from Lead into Gold. Travel through the Cosmic Ages of the Great Year, pursuing this transformation under the watchful gaze of the Fates, the eternal guardians of the Crucible of Kismeta.
game.agy.playTime: 1st Play/Quickplay ~ 1–2 hrs. | Standard ~ 2–3 hrs. | Magnus Alchemist ~ 3+ hrs.
game.tva.summary: Ascend through your seven chakras to gain enlightenment before you are corrupted by the chaotic energy of the Aethereal Veil. Each round, build a three-card spread and try to outscore the Table's hand without going over the 50-point threshold. Victories move you upward on your ascension path while defeats add to your corruption level.
